edge_cases.rationale: Fallback labelling is exemplary but only success-path insertions are exercised — no invalid-position or parse-error branch.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite renders honestly at 3 pass / 4 fail.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP 2026-08-16: ran before/prepend/append insertions; sandbox updated with honest per-call fallback notices; zero console errors.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: clicked beforeHTML/prependHTML/appendHTML; nodes appeared in the sandbox with each call honestly labelled as the insertAdjacentHTML fallback on this pre-151 build; zero console errors.
